title: DynamicDateRange
description: Select a date expression using presets, relative periods, or absolute dates and times.

usage.summary: Choose a date filter that can resolve relative to when it is run.
useWhen: Offer presets such as Today, Last 7 Days and Next 2 Months in a report filter.
Allow relative and absolute periods in the same field.

avoidWhen.when: Enter only a fixed start and end date.
